A medium-trajectory grenade that detonates on impact, creating a spherical Slowing Field with a 4 meter radius.

The detonation deals up to <pve 20 /> <pvp [20] /> damage in a ? meter radius and applies <pve 20 /> <pvp [10] /> stacks of <stasis Slow /> for 2 seconds.

The Slowing Field deals <pve 1 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and applies <pve 10 /> <pvp [5] /> stacks of <stasis Slow /> for 2s every <pve 0.35 /> <pvp [0.3] />s for 7s within its 4 meter radius.

<stasis Whisper of Durance /> extends each <stasis Slow /> linger by 2s and the Slowing Field's duration by 2s.
